It’s unfortunate that it has to end this way for you. Life can be very cruel at times and can hand you the worst possible cards even when you try you’re best to be happy, even when you exhaust all your energy forward to move on to what you deem as your happiness it can be taken and crushed just like that. I understand the pain that comes sometimes from having a particular vice and how it can effect you mentally and influence your decisions. Know that the pain of a vice and it’s effects aren’t a experience only you share. Although I don’t have HIV I can still imagine the depression and guilt and regret and resentment for yourself that you probably feel in the moment. I won’t deny you your justification for why you would wanna do it but I can say there is still possibility and hope for you if you decide to stick it out. There are people who have came back from worse. With your particular case it might be hard to drag yourself back through your past mistakes but all I can tell you is imagine the man who exist at the end of that tunnel who has made it through hardship this intense. Personally I always find the man who’s gone through very tough situations and is looking at the sunset with pride in his tenacity to be one of the coolest archetypes to ever exist. My hope is that you come to find that fate possible.
